The university marks identify the institutions in the Education section.

- HIT: original PNG from the [official emblem page](https://www.hit.edu.cn/12254/list.htm).
  Source image: https://www.hit.edu.cn/_upload/article/images/d3/ec/8fcaa5d24cb59a8e9660324ef50b/735df70a-538b-4bd6-8e52-3f373085a616.png
- HKUST: original vector geometry from the [official brand story](https://hkust.edu.hk/about/brand-story?cn=1).
  Source SVG: https://hkust.edu.hk/sites/default/files/2024-03/HKUST_logo_1.svg
  The SVG viewBox shows the emblem while keeping its geometry and proportions intact.
